# package logging

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/iec61850ctl/pkg/logging"
```

Package logging builds the structured (log/slog) logger used by the CLI and passed to go-iec61850 / go-mms via their Logger options.

## Constants

```go
const (
	LevelOff   = "off"
	FormatText = "text"
	FormatJSON = "json"
)
```

Levels and formats accepted by New.

## Functions

### func New

```go
func New(w io.Writer, level, format string) (*slog.Logger, error)
```

New returns a logger writing to w at level in format (text or json). Level "off" returns a logger that discards everything.

### func ParseLevel

```go
func ParseLevel(s string) (level slog.Level, enabled bool, err error)
```

ParseLevel maps debug|info|warn|warning|error|off (case-insensitive) to a slog level. off reports ok=false with a nil error.
